licenseNotes: Original composition for LifePatch — 'The Debtor's March'. No existing song, beat, melody, riff, drop or arrangement was referenced or transcribed; Papers, Please and Undertale were mood and instrumentation references only. Rendered live from Tone.js synthesis, so there are no third-party samples anywhere in the cue.
sourceNotes: Procedural; phases `intro` and `title` of src/audio/AudioEngine.ts, built from the data in src/audio/score.ts (the single source of musical truth — CHORDS/ROOTS/LEAD_THEME/KEYS_FIGURES/BASS_LINE/SNARE_PATTERN/TICKS_PATTERN/PRESETS/INTENSITY_RULES/STINGERS/VOICES). One continuous 16-bar cycle: Dm - Bbmaj7 - Gm - A - Dm - F - C - A7 (i - bVImaj7 - iv - V - i - III - bVII - V7), two bars per segment. Bars 1-8 are the state closing in; bars 9-16 are the debtor answering. Bar 16 is a V7 half-cadence whose last two 8ths restate A4 A4 as an anacrusis into bar 1's D4 D4, so the loop seam sits INSIDE a rhythmic gesture rather than between two of them. 108 BPM is chosen because 44100 x 60 / 108 = 24,500 samples per beat exactly (bar = 98,000, cycle = 1,568,000), so loop points are sample-exact. LEVELS: intensityLayers 0 and 1 are the `intro` preset at intensity 0 and 1 — the same stems throughout, leaning harder (snare 0.45 -> 0.75, ticks 0.30 -> 0.52, tension 0.50 -> 0.80 per INTENSITY_RULES.intro). Level 2 is the `title` preset: the tension layer is gone and the tune arrives (lead 0.7, counter 0.25) — the anthem is earned, not given. WIRED: components/cinematic/ColdOpen.tsx holds each beat of lib/cinematic.COLD_OPEN to the next BEAT boundary of this grid (hooks/useBeatClock `ceil`), never shorter than the beat's authored reading-time floor — bar-quantizing the cuts was rejected because the floors turn it into up to 2.2s of dead screen per line. Each beat's accent is requested ACCENT_PREROLL_MS (120ms, comfortably under one 8th = 277.78ms) before its cut so AudioEngine.accent()'s own 8th-note quantization resolves it onto the cut. The `title-detonation` cue point is the IDEAL landing — the top of the defiance half, where the tune's 'we're still here' declamation begins — but the accent is actually fired when ColdOpen finishes and is quantized to the next 8th, so it is beat-locked rather than bar-fixed. Visual pacing is identical when muted or before unlock (silent performance.now() grid at the same tempo). The `title` accent is A4 -> C#5 -> D5 as three crisp 8ths (brass-pluck, doubled one octave down) over a D2 membrane boom and a snare ruff, ~1.1s total: it replaces the previous held-chord blast, which sustained a PolySynth stack for a full measure and was the sound players called 'beeping'. STINGER_MAX_SOUNDING_SEC now caps every accent at one bar (2.222s) including release. See .claude/audio/qc/cue-plan.md and .claude/audio/qc/title-theme.json.
